The internal illustration uses the published frame envelope and official
photographs as references. It contains no downloaded supplier CAD or mesh.
Its internal dimensions are estimates for visual guidance. It is not an OEM
model, a measured reverse-engineered part or a manufacturing specification.
The rear label is neutral and does not reproduce supplier labeling.
